content.title: Will You Make a Place for Us in Your Sujood?
content.subtitle: We Need You by Our Side in This Struggle to Protect Our Faith.
content.body:
Looking at the turbulent times we live in today, our hearts grow heavy. Everywhere we look, there is fitnah. The temptations on the streets may sometimes be avoided by turning away, but what about digital fitnah? It has crept into our bedrooms, living rooms, and even the pockets of those standing on their prayer mats. A single tap on our phones can expose us to countless temptations. One careless click can dim the light in our hearts and destroy years of carefully preserved good deeds.

Standing Against an Unequal Tide

As the purity of our eyes and the innocence of our children were sinking into this overwhelming darkness, we could not simply stand by and watch. Our dream of providing future generations with a safe and halal digital environment seemed almost impossible.

But you stood beside us from the very beginning. Your unwavering trust, moral encouragement, and financial support have inspired us to keep moving forward. Because you are with us, even our small team has the courage to stand firm against this immense fitnah. May Rabbul Alamin reward you abundantly. Ameen.

The Relentless Effort Behind the Scenes

Keeping these platforms running around the clock for millions of people is no easy task. Our engineering, support, marketing, and operations teams work tirelessly behind the scenes. Alongside their efforts come enormous server maintenance costs, regular technical expenses, and the challenges of managing daily operations. Yet, our workforce remains extremely limited compared to the scale of our responsibilities.

A Commitment Greater Than Personal Comfort

Our team is small, so our brothers hardly have any days off. Under the blue glow of their monitors, late nights often turn into early mornings. They have placed this sacred responsibility above personal leisure, family moments, time with their wives, and even weekly rest.

They are not driven by worldly fame or material gain. Their motivation comes from a single commitment: to honor the sacred trust you have placed in us and protect future generations from the dangers of the digital world. We pray that we never have to stand before our Lord with regret for failing in this responsibility.

The Reward That Makes Us Forget Our Exhaustion

Whenever we read messages in our inbox or reviews on the Play Store and App Store, our hearts fill with emotion.

When parents express relief at being able to protect their children from harmful online content through Kahf, or when a brother shares how Allah guided him back to the path of faith through our platform after he had drifted away, we feel deeply moved.We are equally touched when families tell us that they observe the Ayyam al-Bid fasts together, follow the app's schedules, and fill their homes with morning and evening adhkar and Quran recitation.

At such moments, tears of gratitude roll down our cheeks. We long to fall into sujood and say, “O Allah! If even one family from this Ummah is saved, then our sleepless nights and silent sacrifices have been worthwhile. Please accept all of us.”

A Small Request from Our Hearts

You have always supported us with love and sincerity. Today, with that same closeness and affection, we have just one small request: Please remember us in your duas. We ask for nothing more than a heartfelt prayer for us in your private moments of worship.

When the noise of the world fades and you raise your hands before your Lord in the stillness of the night, or bow your head in sujood and pour your heart out to Him, will you remember us too, even for a moment?

Even now, as you read these words, please whisper from the depths of your heart: “O Allah, accept our brothers and their efforts!”

Pray that Allah keeps our intentions free from showing off and arrogance. May He grant us the strength to remain steadfast in our mission and vision despite every obstacle. And may He allow this humble service, established to protect the Ummah, to continue until the Day of Judgment. Ameen.
